text.en:
All personnel in the Bureau of Mines holding classified positions not covered by Presidential
Decree No. 398 shall receive monthly incentive allowance in accordance with the following rates:
Salary Range BracketAnnual Salary IncentiveMonthly Allowance
64 and aboveP13,824 and aboveP1,000
Below 44Below P5,112400

The sum of Four Million Three Hundred Seventy Six Thousand Four Hundred Pesos
(P4,376,400) is hereby appropriated for this purpose to be taken from savings of the Bureau of Mines.
Thereafter, the necessary amount shall be included in the annual General Appropriation Decree.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
